properties.title: Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): Administrative Unit Center Points with Population Estimates, Revision 10
properties.description: The Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): Administrative Unit Center Points with Population Estimates, Revision 10 consists of UN WPP-adjusted population estimates and densities for the years 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015 and 2020, as well as the basic demographic characteristics (age and sex) for the year 2010. The data set also includes administrative name, land and water area, and data context by administrative unit center point (centroid) location. The center points are based on approximately 13.5 million input administrative units used in GPWv4, therefore, these files require hardware and software that can read large amounts of data into memory.
properties.sci:citation: Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University. 2017-12-22. Gridded Population of the World, Version 4 (GPWv4): Administrative Unit Center Points with Population Estimates, Revision 10. Version 4.10. ESDIS. Palisades, NY. https://doi.org/10.7927/H46H4FCT
ciesin:authors: Center for International Earth Science Information Network - CIESIN - Columbia University
ciesin:publishers: NASA Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC)
properties.ciesin:purpose: To provide a vector (point) version of the input administrative units used in GPWv4 with population estimates, densities, 2010 basic demographic characteristics, and administrative name, area, and data context for use in data integration.
